close_reason: Added bounded scan: MAX_THREAD_SCAN=5000 articles with early-exit when all requested threads found. Full index requires schema change (TODO in code).
description: In server.rs route_method Thread/get, all groups are iterated and for each group the full lo..hi range is fetched from the overview store, then all CIDs are batch-looked-up. This is O(total articles across all groups) per Thread/get call regardless of how many thread IDs are requested. With a large corpus this will cause multi-second latency on every Thread/get. RFC 8621 requires Thread/get to be responsive. The issue is architectural: thread membership is resolved by scanning all articles, not by indexed lookup.
title: Thread/get loads entire article corpus per request
